remarks: This exceptional Modern estate, originally crafted by Skyview as the builder's own residence, is available in as-new condition and enhanced by inspired customization. Set on 2+/- private acres in Coleytown, adjacent to the Paul Newman-Poses Nature Preserve, the home is approached by a long, gated drive that opens to a motorcourt ideal for grand entertaining. Triple-glazed Klar Studio windows frame the natural surroundings, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor connection. ICF construction, a lifetime Davinci roof & Viessmann boiler with radiant heat throughout ensure enduring quality. Tall ceilings, dramatic glass-lined stairs, curated lighting & a warm minimalist aesthetic define the interiors. The Great Room offers three exposures & the 1st of four fireplaces. The Miele-appointed kitchen features custom cabinetry & a pantry that flows to the dining rm w/illuminated ceil. The fam rm opens to a heated porch w/fireplace; the vast rear skylit porch leads to the pool, summer kitchen & spa. The finished LL now includes a gym, speakeasy-style pub & a kids climbing gym. Epic primary suite. Freshly painted and meticulously maintained throughout, offered in true move-in-ready condition. No new construction compares.
